response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT si.healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scancount, AVG(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin != 0 THEN sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as avg_gb_per_scan_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), mean_of_averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_min) as mean_avg FROM status_averages WHERE avg_gb_per_scan_min IS NOT NULL) SELECT sa.healtheval, sa.total_scancount, sa.avg_gb_per_scan_min, sa.avg_gb_per_scan_min - mo.mean_avg as gap_from_mean FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages mo WHERE mo.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa.healtheval
